• **Audit** current coaches' engagement levels and energy with center directors within 3 days—identify any performing below standard before cancellations occur.

• **Assign** a named backup coach to every center immediately, communicated to the facility, so no gaps exist when primary coaches leave or underperform.

• **Conduct** unannounced observations of at least one session per coach this week to verify engagement and quality match center expectations.

• **Schedule** weekly check-ins with centers currently at risk (those with new or recently changed coaches) to catch dissatisfaction early.
